audience: learning and HR teams that run courses, learning paths and groups in 360Learning

useCases.title: Track learner progress on a learning path
useCases.text: List the sessions and enrollments of a learning path. Read the aggregated learner statuses for one session.

useCases.title: Review published courses and their statistics
useCases.text: List courses, filtered by status, type, group or author. Read the attempt statistics per course or user.

useCases.title: Look up the members of a group
useCases.text: List groups, then the users with their roles in one group, such as learner or coach. Read one user's profile.

useCases.title: Give a user a role in a group
useCases.text: Add a role, such as learner or coach, to a user in a group. Adding a role the user already has changes nothing.

useCases.title: Remove a role from a user in a group
useCases.text: Remove a role from a user in a group. The user loses the access that the role gives.

useCases.title: List custom fields and live classrooms
useCases.text: List the custom fields for users, courses or paths, and the classrooms with live sessions.
